Prepared 21 September 2026. **Not published or scheduled.** Final organiser recheck and live asset hosting are still required.

## Social caption

Shaun the Sheep has gone full mad scientist — and Bristol's smaller scientists have a mission. 🐑⚡

From Saturday 26 September, Bristol Dockyards turns into a science lab. Hunt down bonkers challenges across the site, help power up the SS Great Britain and earn your place among the official Ma-ad Scientists.

🧪 26 September–1 November  
🌦️ Challenges indoors and outdoors  
🎟️ Included with Bristol Dockyards admission  
👨‍👩‍👧 Under-14s need an adult

Book online: £14.50 child / £22 adult. A full-price ticket gives the named ticket holder return visits for a year. Shorter afternoon plan? Entry from 2.30pm is £13 online.

Parking is £5.60 for up to five hours, and Bristol's Clean Air Zone may apply. The organiser does not publish a numerical recommended age for the challenge, so check the activity description before booking for very young children.

Save this for your next Bristol mission 🧡

## Subscriber email draft — unsent

**Subject:** A woolly science mission is landing in Bristol

**Preheader:** Indoor and outdoor challenges at Bristol Dockyards from Saturday 26 September.

A new family mission lands at Bristol Dockyards this Saturday.

Ma-ad Science Mayhem sends children around the site to tackle science challenges and help power up the SS Great Britain. The activity runs indoors and outdoors, making it a more weather-proof option than the average weekend expedition.

It runs from 26 September to 1 November and is included with admission. Online general admission is £14.50 for a child and £22 for an adult; the full-price ticket includes named return visits for a year. There is also an Afternoon Saver from 2.30pm for £13 online.

Children under 14 need an adult. Parking is £5.60 for up to five hours, and Bristol's Clean Air Zone may apply. The organiser has not published a numerical recommended age, so check the description before booking for very young children.

See the organiser details:  
https://www.bristoldockyards.org/whats-on/ma-ad-science-mayhem

Find more Bristol ideas:  
https://donext.co.uk/bristol/

Checked 21 September 2026. Recheck before sending.
